layouts.name: Rushmore Arena
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The club identifies Rushmoor Arena as its sprint venue. The supplied historical configuration identifies the simple northern-straight, eastern diagonal and western Arena Lane triangle, rather than the club’s 2026 figure-eight sprint. Exact public OSM road nodes from Arena Lane 69713123 and eastern service road 371693606 form the independently mapped 1,305.3 m closed triangle. Pinned Environment Agency 2020 one-metre LiDAR intensity imagery confirms all three connected paved sides. The current figure-eight, southern Castle Road approach, Claycart Road, start spur, paddock and field-edge paths are excluded. The 23.7 m difference from the supplied 1,329 m remains explicit; private diagram coordinates are not used. Historical travel direction, temporary course markers and exact racing-line placement remain draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1305.3 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
